temperature.observed: unset: not sent; set to 0.37: sent as temperature

max_output_tokens.observed: unset: not sent; set to 777: sent as max_tokens

max_steps.native: Runner.run max_turns, set per turn to the steps left
max_steps.observed: max_steps 3: 3 model calls, end_state step_limit, harness counted 3

parallel_tool_calls.observed: unset: not sent; set to False: sent as parallel_tool_calls

memory.observed: a plain Agent has no memory; SDK sessions are opt-in and not used (earlier turns are carried in process as the input list)

skills.observed: a plain Agent has no skills; they live in the opt-in SandboxAgent, which is not used

compression.observed: the SDK never compresses; the full input list is sent on every call

known_differences: Each tool definition carries "strict": false, added by the SDK; name, description and parameters are the server's, unchanged (convert_schemas_to_strict off)
MCP tool results go back as a list of content parts ([{"type": "text", "text": ...}]), not a string; error results the SDK writes itself are plain strings

Malformed tool-call arguments: the model gets the SDK's fixed text 'An error occurred while running the tool. Please try again.' and is not told the JSON was invalid (D18; the SDK default is kept, which text to expose is open)
A tool call that raises (an MCP timeout or a broken session) gets the same fixed text (read from the SDK source; not run)
Unknown tool: the model gets "Tool '<name>' not found.", with no list of the available tools (tool_not_found_behavior=return_error_to_model; the SDK default raises and ends the run)

All tool calls of one model turn run concurrently (ToolExecutionConfig.max_function_tool_concurrency is left at the SDK default). With parallel_tool_calls false the model should send one call per turn
Requests carry a User-Agent: Agents/Python 0.24.0 header (models/chatcmpl_helpers.py; headers are not captured by the gate)
